meta.description: Read, inspect, write, transform, and safely preflight local DICOM datasets and pixel data using pydicom 3.0.2. Covers DICOM metadata access, transfer syntaxes, compression/decompression plugins, frame extraction, private elements, DICOM JSON, and bounded de-identification review. Strong PHI safety boundaries with helper CLIs for metadata extraction, inventory, codec inspection, frame planning, rendering, and pseudonymization.

scientific_integrity.detail: Strong safety boundaries: authorized data only, pydicom not diagnostic viewer, de-identification requires expert verification, never claim compliance

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear scope: general DICOM framework not diagnostic tool; pixel output/validation are not diagnostic claims; de-identification is context-specific

methodological_ground.detail: Based on pydicom 3.0.2 (fixes CVE-2026-32711) with DICOM PS3.3/3.5/3.6/3.15 references, current API patterns, migration notes

code_usability.detail: Production-ready with 7 helper CLIs (metadata, inventory, codec, frame planning, rendering, anonymization, audit), exact pinning, security guidance

functional_suitability.note: Complete DICOM workflow: read with bounds, dataset/sequence access, UID/transfer syntax, pixel/frames, compression, JSON, private tags, de-identification

reliability.note: Excellent safety: CVE fix documented, explicit input limits, API migration notes (dcmread not read_file), pixel plugin matrix, de-identification warnings

performance_context.note: Strong optimization: stop_before_pixels, specific_tags, defer_size, frame-specific decoding, iter_pixels for multi-frame; SKILL.md 382 lines well-structured

agent_usability.note: Outstanding: choose-the-workflow section, 7 CLIs mapped to use cases, 2 reference files, security boundaries upfront, migration notes prominent

human_usability.note: Clear triggers (DICOM, medical imaging, PACS, de-identification), mandatory safety boundary section first, workflow selector, helper CLI index

security.note: Exceptional: PHI handling protocol, never print dataset by default, pseudonymization key as secret, bounded parsing, pickle safety, metadata redaction

maintainability.note: Excellent: 2 reference files (transfer syntaxes, common tags), exact pydicom 3.0.2 pinning, optional plugin pins, migration notes, verification date 2026-07-23

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with medical imaging workflows; deterministic for same input; minor: integration with medical imaging analysis skills could be clearer

inputs.label: Safe dataset reading with specific_tags and stop_before_pixels

assertions.text: dcmread with stop_before_pixels=True for metadata-only work
specific_tags parameter with allowlist for minimum exposure
Never print(ds), repr(ds), or iterate values into logs on clinical data
Returns FileDataset with file_meta, preamble, original encoding

inputs.label: Dataset creation with FileMetaDataset and enforce_file_format

assertions.text: FileMetaDataset for group 0002 with Transfer Syntax UID
Consistent SOP UIDs between dataset and file-meta
dcmwrite with enforce_file_format=True, overwrite=False
generate_uid() for new instance creation

inputs.label: Pixel data with stable pydicom.pixels API and transforms

assertions.text: pixel_array(path, index=0, raw=False) for single frame
assertions.note: Current stable API with frame-specific reading

assertions.text: Shape semantics documented: (frames, rows, columns) for multi-frame grayscale
apply_modality_lut then apply_voi_lut for grayscale display
Never use per-frame min/max normalization for quantitative analysis

inputs.label: Compression and decompression with plugin matrix
inputs.note: Transfer syntax handling with codec dependencies

assertions.text: Dataset.decompress() changes in place, sets Explicit VR Little Endian
Dataset.compress(uid) with new SOP Instance UID by default
Plugin capabilities inspection required before processing
Lossy compression acceptability outside pydicom scope

inputs.label: De-identification workflow with UID mapping and key management
inputs.note: DICOM PS3.15 Annex E profile with security requirements

assertions.text: 9-step workflow: purpose definition, profile selection, preserve sources, recursive application, UID replacement, dates, pixels, rebuild meta, audit
Pseudonymization keys are re-identification secrets requiring managed storage
assertions.note: Critical security requirement for deterministic pseudonymization

assertions.text: Bundled script sets PatientIdentityRemoved=NO because cannot establish success
assertions.note: Honest limitation: tool doesn't claim compliance

assertions.text: Never claim DICOM PS3.15, HIPAA, GDPR compliance from tag-removal script
assertions.note: Strongly stated but could be more prominent given high-stakes context

inputs.label: Helper CLIs with dependency-free help and PHI-safe output

assertions.text: All --help paths dependency-free (no pydicom import required)
No network access and emit no DICOM values beyond technical allowlists
anonymize_dicom.py with --generate-uid-key for secure key creation
All 7 CLI scripts verified in scripts/ directory
assertions.note: CLIs documented but directory not fully verified

key_strengths: Exceptional PHI safety: mandatory authorization, never print dataset by default, pseudonymization keys as secrets, bounded parsing, metadata redaction in CLIs
Outstanding de-identification guidance: 9-step workflow, DICOM PS3.15 grounding, honest limitations (never claim compliance), pixel/overlay/graphics warnings
Strong security: CVE-2026-32711 fix documented, pickle safety warnings, input limits, plugin trust model, managed key storage requirements
Excellent API coverage: current pydicom 3.0.2 patterns with migration notes from deprecated APIs (read_file, write_like_original, pixel_data_handlers)
Production-ready with 7 helper CLIs covering metadata, inventory, codec inspection, frame planning, rendering, anonymization with dependency-free --help
